title: Fantasy football rankings Week 1: Sleepers, starts, projections
content:
The wait is finally over … well, almost. Waiting for Week 1 of the NFL season has required nearly as much patience as biding our time until the final Spider-Verse movie drops (June 2027), but we made it, and now it’s time to stress over your Week 1 fantasy football lineups. If you’re new to these, welcome, and get ready for rankings mixed with notes, insights, upside start suggestions, and, of course, because I’m a ’90s kid who never grew up, video game and pop culture references, and more.

Before we get into the “norm,” you will want to check this out!

You know there’s nothing I enjoy more than chatting it up with you in the comments — whether talking movies, DuckTales, or answering your start/sit questions.

Occasionally, I need to take a break from analyzing fantasy questions to, say, eat, sleep, play with the pups and let my wife know I exist in the NFL season. That’s why we’ve enlisted some help.

Meet The Fantasy Concierge!

Here’s how it works: Type in the names of up to five players, select your scoring format and the position(s) you want to compare, and click the analyze button to see who I’d recommend starting this week, along with recent related coverage from The Athletic’s NFL and Fantasy teams.

Ranks need context. This year, each skill position will still have notes for potential changes based on news, injuries, weather, etc. Rankings are updated all week and always before kickoff on game day (except Monday, because they’re locked).

As mentioned, and because I rank everything from cereal to games to the coolest athletes to hang out with, I like to have some fun with random rankings. Feel free to suggest yours, as most all of them have … “Made the list!” (Yes, I ranked wrestlers and their intros too). To kick things off since it’s been a while (Aaron Lewis, Staind voice), I start Week 1 each year with the best movies since we’ve last ranked things.

Plan to see: “Coyote vs. Acme,” “By Any Means,” “Runner,” “Heart of the Beast,” “Resident Evil,” “Street Fighter,” “Clayface,” “Godzilla Minus Zero,” “Violent Night 2,” “Avengers Doomsday”

(Hey, listen! 🧚 It’s mine 👀)

🚨 HEADS UP 🚨

🚨 HEADS UP 🚨 These can differ from my rankings, and MY RANKS are the order I’d start players outside of added context, such as, “Need highest upside, even if risky.” Also, based on 4-point TDs for QB, 6-point rest, and Half-PPR
